list.title: Workflows
list.description: Who approves what. Approvals for forms are built with their form; the built-in ones decide about access, changes and other module records.
list.perForm: Each form chooses its own workflow.
list.noDefault: Not in use — no approval needed until you choose a default.
list.empty: No approval set up: these go ahead without one.

create.title: New workflow
create.description: Choose what it decides about. You can start blank or from a copy.
create.name: Name
create.formHint: Approvals for forms are easiest to build from the form itself: open it and use its Approval tab.

list.formsDescription: Each form names its own approval. Build and change them from the form's Approval tab.
list.formsEmpty: No form has an approval yet.
list.builtInDescription: Decisions the platform's areas ask for. Required ones always run; the others run once you set them up.

issues.empty: Add at least one step — an empty workflow would approve everything automatically.
issues.quorumInvalid: The number of approvals needed is higher than the number of approvers.
issues.requesterApprover: The requester can't be an approver.
issues.remindAfterDue: The reminder must come before the deadline.
issues.incomplete: Choose a person, group, role or field for every approver.
issues.unknownGroup: A group in this step no longer exists.
issues.unknownRole: A role in this step no longer exists.
issues.unknownUser: A person in this step is no longer active.
issues.unknownRecordType: A field the approver fills in offers a record type that doesn't exist.
issues.stepFact: This step uses a field of a step that doesn't come before it (or that the step no longer has).
issues.stepFields: A field the approver fills in depends on an unknown field or on itself, or has an invalid default.

builder.title: Workflow builder

approval.name: Approval
approval.hint: Ask people to approve or reject

condition.name: Decision
condition.hint: Take a different path depending on the request

parallel.name: In parallel
parallel.hint: Several approvals at the same time

notify.name: Notification
notify.hint: Let people know, no decision needed

builder.selectStep: Select a step on the canvas to edit it.
builder.name: Name
builder.factsFromFormHint: Conditions can then test the form's answers (for example the estimated cost).
builder.usedByDefault: Every new request of this type.
builder.incomplete: Some approvers are incomplete — choose who they are first.
builder.published: Published version {version} — new requests use it now
builder.fixIssues: Fix the highlighted steps before publishing

hints.department-head: The manager of the person's department.
hints.requester: The person who sent the request.
hints.fact-group: Any member of the group named in this field approves, e.g. the support group of the picked CI.

approvers.pickGroupFact: Choose a field that holds a group
approvers.noGroupFacts: No field holds a group yet. Choose a form with a record field (for example a CI and its support group) under “Use the fields of”.
approvers.eachHint: One approval per group or person in the field. With “Every approver”, each of them must approve (for example the owner group of every picked CI).

editor.stepFieldsHint: Asked with the decision (for example an evaluation result or a completion date). Kept on the request; later steps can test them.
editor.noStepFields: None: approvers only approve or reject.
editor.fieldsMax: A step can ask for at most {max} fields.
editor.requiredOn: Required fields must be filled in
editor.fieldSheetDescription: Approvers of this step see it next to Approve and Reject.
editor.name: Step name
editor.whenHint: Skip this step for requests that don't match.
editor.whenEmpty: Add what a request must match for this step to run.
editor.onlySometimes: Only run this step in some cases
editor.approversHint: Each line is one approver. A group or role counts as one: any member can answer.

modeHints.any: The first approval or rejection decides the step.
modeHints.all: Every approver must approve; any rejection rejects.
modeHints.quorum: The step is approved once enough approvers agree.

editor.deadlineHint: Remind, escalate or decide automatically when approvers take too long.

breach.notify: Notify the approvers that it's overdue

editor.allowDelegation: Approvers can hand it to someone else
editor.allowSelf: The requester may approve their own request
editor.allowSelfHint: Off by default — keep duties separated.
editor.pathsHint: The first path whose rules match is taken; otherwise the last one.
editor.pathSteps: {count, plural, one {# step} other {# steps}} in this path
editor.branchesHint: All branches run at the same time; the step finishes when every branch is approved.
editor.recipientsHint: They get an in-app notification (and email, if they want it).

nobody.reject: If no approver is found: reject
nobody.skip: If no approver is found: skip the step

test.intro: Try the workflow with example values and decisions. Nothing is saved or sent.

builder.startHint: Add the first step with the + on the canvas.
builder.editInForm: Its form's Approval tab shows the form's questions and this approval together.
builder.archiveBody: New requests can't use it any more. Requests already in progress continue. You can restore it later.
builder.archiveBodyUsed: {count, plural, one {# form or role uses it and} other {# forms or roles use it and}} will stop finding an approval until you choose another. Requests already in progress continue.
builder.activityDescription: Who changed or published this approval, newest first.

repeatApprovers.title: When someone already approved this request
repeatApprovers.hint: Count their earlier approval: they are not asked again at a later step, and the approval they gave earlier counts for it.

changePreview.invalid: This proposal can’t be drawn: its graph isn’t a valid workflow.
